description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): uniform grid x = 0.5 + 0.0005*j + 6.18E-8 (j = 0..16999) for ERFC.PRECISE with Excel's own EXP(-(x*x)), to map the piecewise-constant steps of the ERFC relative error (found in kmyst-erfc-jumpzoom) over the whole range. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)).
